div.head: I Cn 17
div.ab: And we forbeodað ordal ⁊ aðas freolsdagum ⁊ ymbrendagum ⁊ lengctendagum ⁊ rihtfæstendagum ⁊ fram Aduentum Domini oð se eahtaþa dæg agán sig ofer Twelftan mæssdæge ⁊ fram Septuagessima oð XV nihton ofer Eastron.

And we forbeodað ordal ⁊ aðas freolsdagum ⁊ ymbrendagum ⁊ le[n]ctendagum ⁊ rihtfæstendagum ⁊ fram Aduentum Domini oð se eahteðe dæg agan sy ofer Twelftadæg ⁊ fram Septuagesima oð fiftene niht ofer Eastran.

We forbeodað ordal ⁊ aðas freolsdagum ⁊ ymbrendagum ⁊ lenctendagum ⁊ [rihtfæstendagum] ⁊ fram Aduentum Domini oð þæt se eahteoða dæg agán sy ofer Twelftadæg ⁊ fram Septuagessima oð fiftyne niht ofer Eastron.

Et festis diebus iuramenta et ferri uel aquę uel huiusmodi legis iudicia (examina) fieri prohibemus et Quatuor temporum et diebus Quadragesimę et aliis legitimis ieiuniis et ab Aduentu Domini usque in octauum diem post duodecimum á Natali et á Septuagesima usque ad XV dies post Pascha.

We forbeodað ordal ⁊ aðas freolsdagum ⁊ ymbrendagum ⁊ lenctendagum [⁊ rihtfæstendagum] ⁊ fram Aduentum Domini oð(ðe) se eahteoða dæg agán sy ofer Twelftadæg ⁊ fram Septuagessima oþ(þe) fiftyne niht ofer Eastron.

And we forbeodað ordal and aðas freolsdagum and ymbrendagum and lengctendagum and rihtfæstendagum and fram Aduentum Domini oð se eahtaþa dæg agan sig ofer Twelftan mæssedæge and fram Septuagessima oð XV nihton ofer Eastron.

And we forbid ordeals and oaths during festivals and the Ember Days and days in Lent, and on legally appointed fast days, and from the Advent till the eighth day after Twelfth Night, and from the Septuagesima till fifteen days after Easter.

And we forbid ordeals and oaths on feasts and Ember Days, during Lent, on legally designated fast days, from Advent until the eighth day after Twelfth Night, and from Septuagesima until fifteen days after Easter.

Und wir verbieten Ordal und [gerichtliche] Eide an Feiertagen und Quatembertagen und Frühlingsfastentagen und Tagen gesetzlichen Fastens und von Adventus Domini bis der achte Tag [13. Januar] über den Zwölften-Festtag vergangen ist und von Septuagesima bis 14 Tage nach Ostern.

And we forbid ordeals and [judicial] oaths on feast-days and Ember days and Lenten days and days of lawful fasting, and from Advent until the eighth day [13 January] after Twelfth Day has passed, and from Septuagesima until a fortnight after Easter.
